title: Charge Removed From Jury Consideration

source.release: 2026 Criminal Jury Instructions (as adopted by the Judicial Council, February 2026)

body: Count[s] ______ charging the defendant with ______ <insert name[s] of offense[s]> no longer need[s] to be decided in this case.
Do not speculate about or consider in any way why you no longer need to decide (this/these) count[s].

bench_notes.text: The court may give this instruction if one or more of the original counts has been removed from the case, whether through plea or dismissal.
